name: They're the Same Picture
aka: Corporate Needs You to Find the Differences
look: Two stacked stills from The Office. Top: hands hold up two blank sheets of paper above a yellow subtitle asking to find the differences between this picture and this picture. Bottom: Pam Beesly, in a pink cardigan, replies flatly that they're the same picture.
text: Corporate needs you to find the differences between this picture and this picture.
use: The two sheets show two things that are supposedly different, often something and its obvious copy or rebrand, and Pam's deadpan reply points out that they are basically identical.
slots: the first thing (left sheet of paper)
the supposedly different thing (right sheet of paper)
describe: the office pam saying there's no difference between two pictures
woman in a pink cardigan looking at two identical papers
corporate needs you to find the differences between this picture
office lady deadpans that two things are the same thing
two blank sheets held up then a woman shrugs them off
origin: Stills of Jenna Fischer as Pam Beesly in the US version of The Office.
